jobs.title: Creative Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
Creative Strategy Manager

*This is a remote position that requires you to work closely and collaboratively with a team. *

 

About Townsquare Ignite:

Founded in 2010, Townsquare Ignite products and solutions are a combination of our owned and operated digital properties, our proprietary digital programmatic advertising platform, and an in-house demand and data management platform collecting valuable proprietary first-party data, and is the fastest growing revenue and profit driver of Townsquare Media.

Our Competitive Advantage:

First-Party Data Collection: As a large-scale digital content publisher, we collect valuable first-party data from our audience, minimizing reliance on third-party data sources.Proprietary Advertising Technology: Our proprietary, all-in-one 360* advertising platform centralizes reporting, operations, and creative in a single streamlined system.Impactful Integration: Our in-house, DSP-agnostic trade desk integrates with more than 10 leading DSPs, giving us access to all major advertising exchanges and mobile app inventory.Massive Reach: We have access to over 250 billion impressions per day.Targeted Solutions and Customer Service: We provide hyper-targeted advertising solutions and offer white glove customer service.Multi-Platform Delivery: Our campaigns are delivered across desktop, mobile, apps, connected TV, email, paid search, and social media platforms, utilizing display, video, and native executions.Creative Support: We have a full-service design and creative team to help clients craft the right message and develop powerful creative for their campaigns. 

The Creative Strategy Manager Opportunity:

Do you know a good digital ad when you see it—and know exactly how to fix a bad one? The Creative Strategy Manager is a key member of our Creative Services team, responsible for transforming client goals and media plans into high-performing, visually compelling digital campaigns.

This role blends creative execution with strategic thinking—writing sharp copy, conceptualizing inventive and creative display and video ads, and ensuring every ad not only looks great but also performs. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, can juggle multiple requests at once, and has a keen eye for detail, design, and results.

 

Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy

Partner with clients and sales to understand campaign objectives and develop creative strategies aligned with their goals.Conduct client calls to refine creative direction, messaging, and KPIs.Recommend creative approaches to maximize campaign performance.Creative Development

Write compelling ad copy for display, social, video and email marketing.Conceptualize digital ad concepts including display, social, video and email marketing and provide impeccable instructions for our production team to create the assetsSelecting images and/or footage or inspirations for digital ads and videos that elevate client campaigns.Review creative assets, make refinements, and ensure brand alignment and effectiveness.Campaign Support

Strategize creative updates to keep campaigns fresh and engaging.Manage multiple requests simultaneously while meeting tight deadlines.Collaborate with team members to continually raise the standard of creative work producedParticipate in regular virtual team meetings with the camera on to foster stronger collaboration and engagement, ensuring active communication and connection with colleagues across departments 

Qualifications:

Strong knowledge of digital ad design principles for display, social, video and email marketing, including typography, color theory, hierarchy, and balance.Proven copywriting skills for digital, social and video marketingUnderstanding of programmatic advertising and campaign strategy.4+ years of relevant experience in digital design, production, or advertising.Ability to manage a high volume of projects while meeting tight deadlines.Exceptional attention to detail and ability to identify what makes an ad effective.Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required. 

Benefits:

Competitive salary + bonus plan 3 Weeks PTO  9 Paid Holidays (2 personal/floating Holidays) Health, Dental, Vision 401(k) + Company Match  Unlimited Growth Potential - Ignite is the fastest growing division of Townsquare Media with upward mobility opportunities  

Why you’ll love working at Townsquare Ignite:

We are a team of driven individuals who push ourselves and those around us to develop personally and professionally. You can expect a dynamic and competitive work environment. To foster your success, you’ll take part in a comprehensive training program, surrounded by a positive and supportive culture that encourages everyone to develop themselves and others. We’ve had countless internal promotions, and our goal is to continue the rapid growth of our company. Whatever your professional goals, you’ll have the opportunity to make steps toward your target and take your career to new heights!

jobs.title: Remote | Brand & Creative Strategy Specialist (Marketing Collateral) — $70–$110/hour
jobs.description:
We are sharing a specialised part-time consulting opportunity for experienced brand, creative direction, and marketing professionals with strong expertise in brand strategy, visual communication, creative development, and marketing collateral.

This role focuses on reviewing professional documents, spreadsheets, and presentation materials related to branding, creative direction, and marketing. Selected experts will assess outputs for strategic alignment, brand consistency, creative quality, factual accuracy, visual effectiveness, and overall professional credibility.

Key Responsibilities

Brand Strategy & Positioning


Evaluate brand strategies, positioning materials, and related work products for quality and consistency

Assess whether messaging and creative recommendations align with stated brand objectives

Review brand narratives, value propositions, and audience positioning

Identify inconsistencies, unsupported assumptions, and weaknesses in brand logic

Apply professional judgement grounded in real-world brand strategy experience
Creative Direction


Review creative concepts, campaign materials, and visual communication approaches

Assess whether creative execution appropriately reflects brand identity and intended objectives

Evaluate visual hierarchy, consistency, clarity, and overall creative quality

Identify weak concepts, inconsistent execution, and aesthetic issues

Review whether creative recommendations are practical and professionally credible
Marketing Collateral


Evaluate brochures, presentations, campaign materials, sales collateral, and other marketing assets

Assess content structure, messaging, visual presentation, and audience relevance

Review consistency of branding, terminology, claims, and key messages

Identify factual, editorial, visual, or formatting issues

Evaluate whether collateral communicates its intended message clearly and effectively
Brand Identity & Consistency


Review materials for consistency with established brand positioning and visual standards

Assess use of messaging, tone, typography, layouts, and other brand elements

Identify inconsistencies across related documents and presentations

Evaluate whether different materials form a coherent brand experience

Review alignment between strategic intent and creative execution
Marketing & Audience Communication


Evaluate materials intended for customers, prospects, partners, or other audiences

Assess whether messaging is clear, persuasive, relevant, and appropriately structured

Review audience targeting and communication priorities

Identify confusing, unsupported, or ineffective messaging

Evaluate whether creative and marketing choices support the intended communication objective
Documents & Presentation Review


Evaluate brand and marketing documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks for accuracy and completeness

Review presentations for narrative flow, visual hierarchy, clarity, and professional polish

Identify factual, aesthetic, editorial, and formatting errors

Assess whether charts, tables, graphics, and other visual elements communicate information effectively

Ensure key messages and recommendations are clearly presented
Structured Evaluation & Feedback


Assess assigned outputs against domain-specific quality criteria

Identify strategic, creative, factual, aesthetic, and presentation weaknesses

Distinguish substantive brand or creative issues from minor production concerns

Provide clear, structured written feedback explaining identified strengths and weaknesses

Apply evaluation standards consistently across different brand and marketing work products
Ideal Profile

5+ years of relevant professional experience in brand strategy, creative direction, marketing, brand management, creative strategy, or a closely related field

Experience as a Brand Manager, Creative Director, Marketing Manager, Brand Strategist, Creative Strategist, or similar professional

Strong practical understanding of brand strategy, creative direction, and marketing collateral
Experience developing or reviewing brand materials, marketing campaigns, presentations, creative concepts, or customer-facing collateral

Strong visual judgement and ability to assess brand consistency and creative quality

Highly proficient with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
Advanced proficiency with PowerPoint / Google Slides
Strong spreadsheet and analytical skills

Native or professional fluency in English
Excellent written communication and ability to provide precise, structured feedback

Strong attention to strategic, creative, visual, and presentation detail

Master's degree or higher from a recognised institution is advantageous
Engagement Details


Part-time independent contractor engagement

Fully remote

Flexible scheduling based on project requirements
Compensation: $70–$110/hour
Work includes evaluation of brand strategies, creative materials, marketing collateral, documents, spreadsheets, and presentation materials

Projects may be extended, shortened, or concluded based on project needs and performance

Work must be completed without using confidential or proprietary information belonging to any employer, client, institution, or other third party

H1-B and STEM OPT support is unavailable for this engagement

jobs.title: Associate Creative Director
jobs.description:
London, Hybrid

This position sits in our Marketing & Technology
service based in London. We combine data, technology, creative and paid media to crack brands’ business problems & drive revenue through a variety of digital marketing solutions like social, influencer, TTL ad campaigns, augmented reality, AI and innovation. Our clients include eBay, easyJet, Just Eat Takeaway and Pepsico.

Job Purpose

We are looking for an Associate Creative Director for an exciting AI client of ours. The work we produce for them is varied and can range drastically from simple BAU creative responses, to in-person creative sprints and even full productions across multiple global markets. So, broad creative experience is required to ensure that whatever the brief, you feel comfortable leading the team and providing clear direction.

As a creative lead on the client, you will be responsible for ensuring creative excellence across all campaigns and projects. You will work with a wider team of creatives, designers, producers etc, providing clear, decisive feedback, guidance and inspiration to support members of the team across these disciplines. As well as building, delegating and empowering the team to confidently take on work, you will be a hands-on creative with a a willingness to ‘get your hands dirty’ to help the team.

Communication & presentation skills are critical due to frequent touchpoints with internal and external senior stakeholders in, both of which are located across the UK and US. You’ll be expected to work fast and nimble, getting work organised and ready to present to client. You will also attend and lead in-person creative sprints & workshops with the wider creative teams as well as the clients internal creative teams.

Key Responsibilities

Craft brilliant, award winning ideas that capture attention and inspire our clients creatives
Create opportunities for account growth through selling brilliant creative campaigns that have community and culture at the heart of them
Strategic thinking to lead your roster of clients to success through excellent creative
Lead, develop, motivate and inspire DEPT’s creative teams and encourage collaboration
Work closely with the accounts team to ensure a smooth monthly production process
Suggest best ways of working, and hustle for the best opportunities
Deliver and inspire innovative and high quality work across all deliverables from the team
Be aware of and respond to current advertising and media trends and pop culture
Use experience and ideas to contribute to the development of our creative process
Present work internally and externally to an excellent standard
Stay up-to-date with industry developments
Initiate and facilitate creative team collaboration and sharing, and team cohesion through social and team building initiatives

Skills And Previous Experience

Be an AI-native and have an interest in AI generally
Strategically minded with the ability to sell bigger ideas
Must be Figma-native (this is where we do 90% of our work/presentations)
Keep up to date with the latest tech/AI trends and have a broad understanding of the competitor landscape.
Strong performance chops
Outstanding portfolio across multiple creative disciplines with examples of tech or AI-led campaigns
Ability to work fast and be decisive
ImageGen skills - using AI to generate high quality imagery (big bonus)
Ability to meet deadlines and collaborate well with the team and clients
High attention to visual and copywriting details
Ability to remain focused under pressure within a fast-paced environment
A love for learning new things and exploring new mediums

WE OFFER

A flexible, hybrid working policy
The choice of medical healthcare providers (Bupa or Medicash)
25 days holiday plus bank holidays and your birthday off each year
Company pension scheme
EAP scheme
Ride to work scheme
Enhanced family friendly policies
Buddy Program: You will be paired with a ‘Buddy’ to help you through your first weeks’ at DEPT®.
A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021 and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.
Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with clients of all sizes and across all industries. And we celebrate all of our successes together!
The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.
Global annual DEPT® Cares Month in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.

WHO ARE WE?

We are pioneers at heart. What does that mean? We are always looking forward, thinking of what we can create tomorrow that does not exist today. We were born digital and we are a new model of agency, with a deep skillset in tech and marketing. That’s why we hire curious, self-driven, talented people who never stop innovating.

Our culture is big enough to cope and small enough to care. Meaning, that with people across 30+ countries, we’re big enough to provide you with the best tools, global opportunities, and benefits that help you thrive. While acting small by investing in you, your growth, your team, and giving you the autonomy to solve our clients problems, no matter where you are in the world.

DEPT® is committed to making a positive impact on the planet and since 2021 has been Climate Neutral and B Corporation certified.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here.

jobs.title: AI Creative Lead (Remote)
jobs.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

Forbes Advisor is hiring an AI Creative Lead to own the generative stack that turns approved scripts and storyboards into finished, on-brand video and static ads. This person is two things at once: a creative with a deep understanding of direct-response marketing, and a hands-on operator who lives in the AI tools daily. You run the back half of our pipeline, from character-locked stills through AI video, lip-sync, and voiceover to editor-ready footage, and you treat every step as a creative call as much as a technical one: what serves the story, what sells, and what will read as a real ad in the feed.

The role reports into the Head of Creative Production and partners with our Creative Directors and Editor/Designers. You know what makes a DR ad work, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, and you know which model(s) to use and why. You can hold character, wardrobe, and continuity across a whole spot, debug a broken render instead of re-rolling, and get renders through touchy platform filters. You have shipped AI-generated video that ran as paid creative, and you can tell real-ad output from output that just reads as AI.

We are a human-led shop that uses AI to move faster without diluting craft. You protect the craft bar rather than lowering it to what the model makes easy, and you stay current with a stack that turns over frequently, treating every tool pick as a short-term decision.

Responsibilities



Own generation end-to-end for paid social and native creative: character-locked stills, AI video, lip-sync, and clean generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to editor-ready footage. Lock base characters first, then build a still per beat that references them, holding character, wardrobe, prop, and continuity consistency across an entire spot. Pick the right model for each job (hero vs. volume, native-audio vs. img-to-video) and keep a live view of a fast-moving tool stack, pinning exact model versions at build time. Scout, test, and onboard new models and tools as the stack evolves, and retire the ones that fall behind, so the team is always working with the best available. Get renders through platform and category filters. Diagnose and auto-fix a broken render once, then escalate, and keep a running swipe of safe phrasings and prompt patterns that pass. Operate and lightly orchestrate the tooling (fan-out, scheduling, asset movement) so many jobs run in parallel without a person babysitting each one. Own the generative-side handoff into post: deliver organized, tagged, editor-ready clips into the DAM to the production team's standards. Feed the shared learnings file (format, copy, render, and legal notes per job) and read it back at the next job's start so the system compounds instead of repeating mistakes. Partner with the Creative Directors and copywriters to keep generated output on-voice, on-persona, and matched beat-for-beat to the script (AV sync). Bring a direct-response creative eye to every job: push each render toward what sells, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, not just what looks good. Operate inside compliance rails for our regulated categories: no better-drug or results claims, coverage/qualify framing, required disclosures, and honest routing. Hold generation to the same gate as the rest of the pipeline. Manage generative tooling spend against render volume, and give the Head of Creative Production a real monthly cost model as volume scales. Build reusable assets (prompt libraries, character references, templates, and workflow docs) that let editors and strategists self-serve the routine work. 

Requirements

4+ years in creative production, motion, VFX, or content, with at least the last 1 to 2 years hands-on in generative AI video and image production for real deliverables. A real grounding in direct-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built (hook, problem, mechanism, proof, offer, and CTA) and can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished. Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI-generated or AI-assisted video and stills, with an honest account of what you made vs. what the model made, and (ideally) how it performed. Deep, current fluency with the generative stack: multi-subject-consistency image models, AI video (native-audio and img-to-video), lip-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on trade-offs, not just tool names. Character and continuity discipline: you can hold a consistent character across many shots and beats, not just generate one good frame. Prompt and troubleshooting fluency: you can diagnose why a render broke or a character drifted and fix it deliberately, rather than re-rolling until something lands. Comfort building light automation/orchestration around the tools (e.g. n8n, Gumloop, or comparable) to fan out and move assets. You don't need to be an engineer, but you're not afraid of the glue. A finishing eye: you know when AI output reads as a real ad vs. a tech demo, and you hold the line on craft. Demonstrated speed and volume in a performance, DR, or high-output content environment. Comfortable shipping many cuts and variants a we

About Krea
At Krea, we are building next-generation AI creative tools.


We're dedicated to making AI intuitive and controllable for creatives - our mission is to build tools that empower human creativity, not replace it. We believe AI is a new medium that allows us to express ourselves through various formats - text, images, video, sound, and even 3D. We're building better, smarter, and more controllable tools to harness this medium. We recently took this a step forward with the launch of Krea 2, our first foundation model, built completely from scratch for aesthetic diversity and stylistic control.


We've raised over $83M and are backed by world-class investors such as a16z, Bain Capital, and Abstract. We work full-time and in-person at our waterfront office in San Francisco. We care about creativity: our team includes musicians, designers, visual artists, and engineers.




This role
We're looking for a Creative Lead to work directly with our enterprise clients and help them get real value out of Krea. You'll run demos, lead workshops, build workflows for their production pipelines, and bring what you learn back to the product team.

Partner with sales to lead product demos

Short-Form Production Track Record: 2–3+ years of experience in video content production, with a heavy specialization in short-form video formats (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts).

As the world's foremost entertainment company, Netflix is looking for thoughtful, collaborative, courageous, and skillful creatives to join our gaming division in order to revolutionize entertainment.



We connect people globally with movies and shows by delivering outstanding content and technological innovation through the world's leading streaming entertainment app, with more than 240 million memberships in over 190 countries. Members can watch as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and now they can enjoy an expanding collection of Netflix curated and produced Games.



At Netflix, we have an insatiable need to continually improve our product experience and the creative elements that support it, providing great value to our members, and this team sits at the forefront of the effort.

Creative Publishing is Netflix's creative leadership for games, maintaining a consistently high bar across our portfolio. We are seeking a highly-skilled Creative Director to help us align vision and player experience across a key portfolio vertical within Netflix Games.

We’re looking for a Creative Director — Art who can raise our creative bar, lead and grow our Art discipline, and help shape the future of Creative at VIVO.


This is a senior leadership role for someone who is as passionate about building as they are about making: building exceptional work, talented teams, strong creative partnerships, better ways of working, and an agency people notice.

You understand how art, copy and strategy come together to create an idea, and you're comfortable helping lead multidisciplinary teams toward work that's strategically smart, beautifully executed and impossible to ignore.

Set the Creative Bar.

Own and elevate the visual and creative standard across VIVO's client and agency work.
Lead the development of integrated ideas across digital, social, video, print, experiential and emerging channels.

Think beyond your own discipline. Bring a strong point of view to concepts, storytelling, creative strategy and the overall quality of our work.
Evolve the structure, capabilities and future of VIVO's Creative department.

Build, Don't Just Maintain.

Identify the talent, capabilities, processes and tools we need for our next stage of growth.
Develop creative leaders—not just great campaigns.
Create an environment where talented people are challenged, supported and able to do the best work of their careers.
Partner Across the Agency.
Work closely with Strategy, Client Services, Project Management, Editorial and Agency Leadership to turn business problems into powerful, creative solutions.
Build trust across disciplines and eliminate the silos that get in the way of great work.
Be someone our teams want in the room for our most important opportunities and our toughest creative challenges.

Help Grow VIVO.

Play a meaningful role in new business, pitches and organic client growth.
Present ideas and creative vision confidently to senior clients.
Identify opportunities to make our existing client work stronger—and our relationships bigger.
Help build VIVO's external creative reputation through award-worthy work, thought leadership and visibility in the industry.

Embrace What's Next.

Bring curiosity—not fear—to emerging technology.
Help us integrate AI and new tools thoughtfully into concepting, design, content development and production while protecting originality, craft and quality.

Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, this team provides consulting, marketing, loyalty and analytics to financial institutions and merchants globally.

The Creative Strategy role within SPD is focused on supporting the strategy development process that fuels innovative client solutions. You’ll work closely with Senior strategists, Creatives, Data analysts to help craft compelling narratives and uncover insights that drive business impact. With deep experience from leading or consolidated creative agencies, the Creative Strategist brings strong strategic judgment, cultural understanding, and creative sensitivity.

jobs.title: Werkstudent Video & UGC Creator (m/w/d) - Meta Ads & KI-Video
jobs.description:
Werkstudent Video \& UGC Creator (m/w/d) \| 100 % Remote \| 13,90 EUR/Std. \| 15\-20 Std./Woche \| ab sofort

Wir sind eine junge E\-Commerce\-Gruppe im Sports\-Memorabilia\-Bereich mit zwei Shopify\-Shops: TheCardClub.de (originale Autogrammkarten von Fußball\- und Basketballstars sowie Trading Card Mystery Packs) und Authentiks (100 % authentifizierte, signierte Fußball\-Trikots im Premium\-Segment). Beide Shops verkaufen fast ausschließlich über Meta Ads. Was am Ende entscheidet, ist das Video.

Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der vor der Kamera steht und das Video anschließend selbst fertig macht. Du bist das Gesicht unserer Ads \- kein Model, sondern jemand, der ein Trikot auspackt, ein Mystery Pack öffnet und in zwei Sätzen erklärt, warum man das haben will.

DEINE AUFGABE

* Vor der Kamera: UGC\-Videos, in denen du selbst sprichst \- Unboxings, Produktvorstellungen, Talking Heads, Reaktionen. Das ist der Kern der Stelle, nicht ein Zusatz
* KI\-Videos produzieren: Higgsfield, HeyGen und Co. für alles, was wir nicht selbst drehen können \- Szenen, Avatare, Voiceover, Animationen
* Selbst schneiden: Schnitt, Untertitel, Text\-Overlays, Hook in den ersten zwei Sekunden, Musik, Export in 9:16, 4:5 und 1:1
* Werbewinkel mitdenken: Welcher Hook, welcher Pain Point, welches Versprechen \- du lieferst nicht nur Material, du entwickelst Ideen
* Was funktioniert, weiterentwickeln: Die Performance\-Zahlen aus dem Meta Ads Manager bekommst du von uns, du baust darauf die nächste Runde
* Organischer Content für Instagram und TikTok, wenn ein Video sich dafür eignet

WAS DU MITBRINGST

* Immatrikuliert an einer Hochschule (Pflicht für den Werkstudentenstatus) \- Studienrichtung ist uns egal
* Du gehst gern vor die Kamera und wirkst dabei natürlich. Wir wollen zwei, drei Beispiele sehen \- eigener TikTok\- oder Instagram\-Account, ein UGC\-Reel, irgendetwas Echtes mit dir darin
* Schnitt beherrschst du selbstständig: CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci oder womit du sonst arbeitest
* KI ist für dich Werkzeug, nicht Zauberei: Higgsfield, HeyGen, ChatGPT, Claude \- und was du sonst nutzt (Runway, ElevenLabs, Midjourney)
* Grundverständnis von Marketing und Werbung: Du weißt ungefähr, wie Meta Ads funktionieren, warum ein Creative verkauft und was eine Marke von einem beliebigen Shop unterscheidet. Wir erwarten keine Agenturerfahrung \- wir erwarten, dass du verstehst, worum es geht, und Lust hast, tiefer einzusteigen
* Zuverlässigkeit und Tempo: lieber Dienstag drei fertige Videos als in drei Wochen der eine perfekte Film
* Bonus: Interesse an Fußball, Basketball oder Trading Cards

WAS WIR BIETEN

* 13,90 EUR/Std., 15\-20 Std./Woche, freie Zeiteinteilung \- in der Klausurenphase runterfahren ist normal und kein Problem
* 100 % remote, deutschlandweit. Produkte zum Filmen (Trikots, Karten, Mystery Packs) schicken wir dir zu
* Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründer, kurze Wege, keine Abstimmungsschleifen
* Deine Videos laufen mit echtem Werbebudget \- du siehst innerhalb weniger Tage an echten Zahlen, was funktioniert hat. Das lernst du in keinem Praktikum so schnell
* Zugang zu unseren KI\-Tools (u. a. Higgsfield), Briefings, Rohmaterial und Marken\-Guidelines kommen von uns
* Echte Einblicke in Meta Ads, Shopify und den Aufbau zweier Marken \- du darfst mitdenken, nicht nur abliefern
* Langfristige Perspektive: Wenn es passt, wächst die Rolle mit

jobs.title: Marketing Creative Lead

There is room for everyone! We empower each other to innovate and create processes that use technology to generate meaningful, lasting change. We enjoy the challenge of finding solutions to problems that are not a way around it but through it. **Visit.org** is a women\-led Certified B Corporation that designs and delivers full\-scale volunteering programs for global companies, with volunteering experiences built with vetted nonprofit partners and rooted in real community needs in 100\+ countries and 40\+ languages. Trusted by teams at companies like Amazon, Colgate, Paramount, and Cisco, Visit.org acts as an extension of lean CSR teams to run global volunteering that employees love and nonprofits trust.

**Responsibilities:**

* Bring fresh ideas, design trends, AI\-powered creative workflows, and new storytelling approaches that help Visit.org stand out in the CSR and employee engagement market.

* 4 to 7 years of experience in graphic design, brand design, or creative roles, with a track record of leading creative work from concept through delivery.

* Experience building and maintaining brand systems, including visual identity guidelines, templates, and asset libraries that scale across teams.

* Highly organized and self\-directed, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and deadlines independently, with minimal supervision.
* Experience working with B2B, SaaS, or mission\-driven brands is a plus.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced startup environment.
* Passion for our mission and the desire to make an impact in the world through technology.
* Must be available to travel as needed to support business objectives. Expected travel may be up to 25% of the time, depending on the role and operational needs.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced startup environment
* Passion for our mission and the desire to make an impact in the world through technology

 **Please note: This is a remote, Mexico\-based 40 hr/week contract position that requires working hours from 9:00 AM \- 6:00 PM EST**

 **Our hiring process includes a portfolio review, interviews, and a short paid design exercise so we can see how you think through a real brief.**

* Competitive salary, benchmarked at the top of the market
* Mission\-aligned company events/volunteering
* Inclusive, exciting start\-up culture
* Accelerated career \& personal growth
* Culture Club and more!

We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Creative Strategy Manager

The Creative Strategy Manager is responsible for helping clients see their challenges differently.

As part of Advisors Creative Desk (ACD) — the creative powerhouse of Mastercard Advisors — they turn business problems, human insights, and cultural shifts into creative opportunities that drive growth and make brands more meaningful.

They are strategist, storyteller, and facilitator in equal measure: someone who can uncover an insight, lead a workshop, write a brief, challenge a room full of opinions, and help a team find the clearest path forward.

Drawing on experience from leading agencies or consultancies, they bring together strategic rigor, creativity, and diplomacy. They provide guidance and quality leadership across projects while remaining hands-on in the work itself—helping transform complexity into clarity, and clarity into great ideas.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Development & Ownership

Lead the development of creative strategies on key briefs

Provide strategic leadership across a portfolio of countries within the European region, identifying cross-market opportunities, sharing best practices, and driving strategic excellence at scale

Translate business objectives, brand challenges, and insights into clear strategic directions and creative platforms

Own strategic thinking across assigned projects, ensuring consistency, clarity, and creative ambition

Insight & Research Excellence

Conduct and guide desk research across markets, competitors, consumers, and cultural trends

Distill complex information into sharp, inspiring insights that unlock strong creative ideas

Push beyond surface-level findings to uncover meaningful and differentiated strategic perspectives

Creative Briefing & Writing

Write high-quality creative briefs that inspire creative teams while aligning internal and client stakeholders

Shape strategic narratives, key messages, and presentation materials for client-facing deliverables

Partner with Creative Strategy Managers on briefing sessions and creative handovers

Collaboration & Diplomacy

Work closely with creatives, account managers, project managers, and clients to ensure smooth strategic delivery

Act as a strategic partner to creative teams throughout the development process, providing constructive feedback and guidance

Navigate differing viewpoints with confidence and diplomacy, balancing creative ambition with client and business realities

Guidance & Quality Control

Support and mentor Creative Strategists, helping elevate strategic thinking, writing, and research quality

Review and refine strategic outputs produced by junior team members

Contribute to the development of strategic best practices, frameworks, and internal tools

All About You

10+ years of experience in creative strategy, brand planning, or communications strategy within a leading creative agency, brand consultancy, or equivalent strategic environment.

Exceptional strategic thinker and writer, able to turn insights into compelling narratives, sharp briefs, and creative opportunities.

Experienced facilitator and storyteller, confident leading workshops, presenting to senior audiences, and aligning diverse stakeholders around a common direction.

Strong collaborator and diplomat, skilled at navigating complexity, balancing competing perspectives, and building trust across clients, creatives, and cross-functional teams.

Comfortable operating across multiple European markets, bringing cultural sensitivity, strategic rigor, and fluent English communication in both written and verbal settings.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!

Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.

As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.

We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.

💻 Role

We're looking for a Performance Creative Lead to join the EU marketing team at Whatnot and build the creative engine that fuels our paid growth across Europe.

You'll own the full paid creative system: the strategy, team, operations, and output that help us produce high-performing ads at scale. You'll work across creator-led ads, in-house production, edited community content, agencies, and creator marketplace platforms. You won't be tied to one way of making creatives - your job is to find the fastest, highest-quality path to assets that perform, including when that means sourcing and managing external partners to scale beyond what the in-house team can produce alone.

We already produce a high volume of creatives today. The next phase is about scaling that output with more intentionality: better systems, sharper creative strategy, stronger testing loops, better localization, and clear answers on which creative investments are driving more first-time buyers at lower cost.

You'll build and manage a team that brings together creative production talent and creator management expertise. You'll be a player-coach: raise the bar, hire strong talent, and still get in the work yourself. At Whatnot, everyone is an IC.

You Will

Own the EU performance creative engine across paid social: you're accountable for the volume and quality of creative Europe ships every month.
Balance performance and brand: push for creative that drives results without letting it drift from what makes Whatnot recognizable and trustworthy.
Build the strategy and operating system to scale creative output while reducing guesswork, improving quality, and increasing creative impact.
Manage and develop a growing team as a player-coach, setting direction and holding a high bar while staying hands-on in the work.
Partner closely with Performance Marketing to build the creative testing roadmap, understand what's working, diagnose performance issues, and turn learnings into better creative.
Lead creative output across multiple pipelines: creator-led ads, in-house production, edited community content, agencies, and creator marketplace platforms, deciding which external partners and platforms are worth investing in and managing those relationships directly.
Build systems that keep working as we scale: briefing, production workflows, asset tracking, localization, creator workflows, and feedback loops.
Partner with the US Performance Creative team so top-performing creative travels between markets, and so Europe adopts and helps improve the tools and playbooks built for global marketing.
Ensure you and your team use data to decide what to repeat, cut, or test next, moving from one-off creative wins to repeatable creative systems.
Stay hands-on when needed: sourcing creators, shaping briefs, reviewing edits, producing assets, jumping into workflows, and unblocking the team.
Drive AI adoption across the team to move faster and build better processes: speeding up research, organizing creative learnings, improving workflows, creating brief variants, summarizing performance insights, localizing inputs, and reducing manual work.

We offer flexibility to work from home or from one of our global office hubs, and we value in-person time for planning, problem-solving, and connection. Team members in this role must live within commuting distance of either our London hub or our Berlin hub.

👋 You

People who do well at Whatnot tend to be comfortable figuring things out as they go, biased toward action, and genuinely curious about what they're building. They care more about outcomes than credit and stay close to the product and the people using it.

You're a performance creative leader who has scaled creative output without losing sight of quality, brand, and business impact, and who stays hands-on, jumping into briefs, edits, creator concepts, or whatever else needs momentum.

You Should Have

Experience building or managing a high-volume performance creative program across multiple workstreams, channels, and markets.
People management experience, including hiring, developing talent, setting direction, and raising the bar for creative output across different functions (e.g. production and creator management).
Experience sourcing, vetting, and managing external partners (e.g. agencies, freelancers, or creator marketplace platforms) as a lever to scale output beyond what an in-house team can produce alone.
Strong paid performance fluency. You can read creative performance data, brainstorm with paid marketers, challenge assumptions, and turn learnings into sharper creative tests.
Strong operating ability. You can build systems for briefing, production, asset tracking, localization, creator workflows, and feedback loops without slowing the team down.
Strong creative taste across short-form video, creator-led ads, UGC, edited assets, and native paid social formats, with the judgment to protect the brand while still making creative that feels native and built to perform.
AI-forward leadership. You drive AI adoption across a team to reduce manual work, improve workflows, speed up research, summarize learnings, localize inputs, and help the team move faster.
A sharp, specific eye for what good looks like: in a brief, a creator concept, a cut, a caption, a final asset.
Comfort working across Europe, where creative needs to be localized by market, language, and customer behavior.

Bonus If You Have

Experience in a fast-growing startup, DTC brand, or marketplace business.
Experience creating assets across multiple communities, product types, or categories.
Interest or experience in collectibles or fashion culture. You understand the tone, trends, and what resonates with these communities.

jobs.title: Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
DEPT® is the Growth Invention Company, sitting at the intersection of marketing and technology. The Senior Creative Strategist role is part of our Creative & Media team based in Amsterdam. Our building is filled with a vibrant mix of talents, ranging from Creatives, Influencer Marketers, and a range of Strategists, to Account Managers, AI Experts, and Marketing Automation Consultants. Together, we blend imaginative storytelling, forward-facing creativity, and cutting-edge technology to create impactful creative work that drives growth for our clients like Netflix, Canva, Stokke, Foot Locker, Philips & Praxis.

Job Purpose

The Creative Strategist at DEPT® are at the heart of the action, operating at the intersection of creativity, culture, humanity, business, and technology - helping create work that moves people and drives growth. We don’t have a proprietary framework or process. We don’t like to follow best practices because they’re based on the past. In a world of constant flux and endless opportunity, we believe strategy is crucial to imagine the path forward.

At this level, you are putting your foundational skills into practice and earning authority with clients and creative teams. While our seniors and directors define the vision, you are the indispensable thinker bringing it to life - owning projects, learning through doing, and finding the insights that spark great work.

Key Responsibilities

Own the project:
Step up to own more projects and see them through from start to finish, utilizing the guidance and air cover of a Senior/Director when you need it.

Interrogate the challenge:
Be a fearless, honest, and suspicious interrogator of the brand, the challenge, and the world it lives in.

Craft the springboard:
Consistently develop strategies, briefs, and thought-starters that excite, inspire and give clear direction.

Think beyond boundaries:
Connect differently shaped projects and strategies in ways that they all lead to effective outcomes.

That’s the core of it. Beyond that, we expect you to care about the work, the craft and humans, be comfortable in front of crowds and workshops, and be utterly yourself at all times.

What We Are Looking For

That’s one list. Sorry, here’s another. It’s about some traits we like:

Relentless curiosity: You love playing the investigative journalist. You get under the skin of the problem, the audience, immerse yourself in the business and throw yourself into culture - all for the betterment of the work (and because there’s no better place than a reddit rabbithole).
Intelligent imagination: You don't just observe; you make leaps of thinking that reveal entirely new ways of looking at a problem or an opportunity.
Effective storytelling: You are skilled in the art of writing, crafting arguments and telling stories in ways that help create clarity, excitement and buy-in for ideas.
Creative development: A strategy isn’t great until it leads to great work. You thrive in inspiring, supporting, protecting, and nurturing creativity from start to finish.
Distilling complexity: The world is increasingly complex and fragmented. You’re able to process, distill, and demystify that chaos into simple and compelling insights.
Finger on the pulse: You know what’s going on in culture, in tech, on social and some other weird corners of the internet, and are able to turn that knowledge into action (or just great water cooler conversation).
Team Player: There’s a perception that the best strategists are mysterious wizards who pontificate from ivory towers - not at DEPT®. Here getting to the best possible work is a team sport. Everyone does their part for the greater good.

Language requirements: We’re looking for someone who can work in Dutch and English. Any other languages are a bonus.

That’s it. Enough lists. If any of this seems right up your alley, we’d love to hear from you.

What Now

Apart from the CV we would like to see:

A short cover letter that tells us a little about you, your background, and what you want to achieve.
It doesn’t need to be super formal. Relax. No one scary will read it. Please write it in your voice.

If you have a portfolio/website, please include it
. It’s helpful to know what your role in the work was. And if you’re not currently a strategist, feel free to include some relevant samples of interesting work from other fields.

WE OFFER

A flexible, hybrid working policy (2-3 days from the office, depending on location) and the opportunity to work from abroad for 13 weeks a year.
24 vacation days per year and the possibility to buy an unlimited number of extra vacation days.
DEPT®/YOU Learning Menu and DEPT®/YOU Special Programs. Develop your skills with courses and programs tailored to your needs.
Stay happy and healthy with a contribution to your health through the OpenUp platform, gym and wellness discounts, and healthy lunches at the office.
Get a discount on your lease bike and ride in style. You can also enjoy hassle free-commutes with an NS Business Card.
A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021, has been named a Great Place To Work since 2022 in the Netherlands and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.
Awesome clients. Whether big, small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with all of them. And we celebrate all of our successes together!
You can discover even more employee benefits here.

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

Deine Aufgaben

Mission

Content für unsere Kunden entsteht bei yoursquares nicht mehr Stück für Stück, sondern über ein System, das du aufbaust. Sobald ein Creative bei einem Kunden zieht, lässt du daraus AI-gestützt binnen kurzer Zeit ein ganzes Set an Varianten entstehen – andere Hooks, neue Formate, kürzere und längere Schnitte – und bringst sie parallel in den jeweiligen Account. Jede Version bleibt klar auf die Marke des Kunden zugeschnitten, und was weiterläuft, entscheiden die Zahlen, nicht das Bauchgefühl.

Produktentwicklung & Workflows

Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Produkt-Team unseren AI-Creative-Stack weiter und gestaltest Systeme, mit denen wir deutlich mehr hochwertige Werbemittel in kürzerer Zeit produzieren können.
Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Content, AI, Performance Marketing und Produkt und übersetzt operative Anforderungen in skalierbare Prozesse und Produktideen
Du musst dabei nicht jeden technischen Prozess selbst programmieren oder bauen. Entscheidend ist, dass du verstehst, was mit AI, Automatisierungen und modernen Tools möglich ist, wo technische Grenzen liegen und wie ein sinnvoller Workflow aussehen sollte
Wenn du Workflows, Automatisierungen oder Prototypen selbst bauen kannst: umso besser. Bei komplexeren Lösungen arbeitest du eng mit unserem Produkt- und Tech-Team zusammen und bringst die fachlichen Anforderungen ein

Automatisierte Content-Produktion

Du arbeitest täglich mit Tools wie Claude Code & Design, Make, Higgsfield. HeyGen, Midjourney, Runway, Nano Banana, und weiteren AI-Tools und verbindest sie sinnvoll miteinander
Du entwickelst Systeme, die aus Projektinformationen automatisiert unterschiedliche Paid-Social-Content, Videos, Landingpages und Creative-Varianten generieren können
Du automatisierst die Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Landingpages und sorgst dafür, dass aus wenigen Inputs möglichst schnell hochwertige, conversionstarke Seiten entstehen
Du entwickelst und automatisierst AI-Video-Workflows – von der ersten Idee über unterschiedliche Hooks und Szenen bis hin zu Varianten, Formaten und Cutdowns

Creative-Produktion & Performance

Du entwickelst High-Performing Creatives für Paid Ads selbst – Static Ads, Video, Motion, Landingpages und neue Formate
Du liest unsere Performance-Dashboards selbst, erkennst Muster und übersetzt die Daten direkt in neue Creative-Hypothesen und Iterationen
Du analysierst unter anderem Hook Rate, CTR, Conversion Rate, CPL, CPA und ROAS und nutzt diese Erkenntnisse, um unsere Creative-Produktion kontinuierlich besser zu machen

Tooling, UX & Marktbeobachtung

Du gestaltest auch die UX/UI unserer internen AI-Tools und Workflows mit. Dein Anspruch: Komplexe Technologie muss so einfach werden, dass jede Person im Team sie intuitiv nutzen kann
Du beobachtest den AI-Markt kontinuierlich und erkennst früh, welche neuen Modelle, Tools und Workflows einen echten Vorteil bringen
Du testest neue Technologien schnell und pragmatisch. Wenn ein neues Tool unseren bestehenden Prozess deutlich verbessert, integrierst du es – statt an bestehenden Lösungen festzuhalten

Das Bringst Du Idealerweise Mit

Du bringst mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Content, Creative, AI, Automation oder einem vergleichbaren digitalen Umfeld mit.
Du bist AI-Native. Claude, Prompting, Make und generative AI gehören für dich zum täglichen Werkzeugkasten und sind keine Buzzwords.
Tools wie Nano Banana, Runway, Midjourney oder vergleichbare Lösungen hast du dir idealerweise selbst beigebracht – und du beschäftigst dich bereits mit den Tools, die sie morgen ersetzen könnten.
Du verstehst nicht nur einzelne AI-Tools, sondern kannst erkennen, wie unterschiedliche Tools zu einem sinnvollen Workflow zusammenspielen.
Du hast Spaß daran, Prozesse zu automatisieren und stellst dir regelmäßig die Frage: Warum machen wir das eigentlich noch manuell?
Du kannst Creatives nicht nur automatisieren, sondern hast selbst ein gutes Verständnis für Design, Content, Paid Social und Conversion.

Geschwindigkeit ist für dich kein Widerspruch zu Qualität. Die Vorstellung, sehr große Mengen an Creative-Varianten zu produzieren und zu testen, motiviert dich eher, als dass sie dich abschreckt.
Gleichzeitig hast du einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch: AI-Output darf nicht billig oder beliebig nach AI aussehen.
Du arbeitest eigenständig, pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert und hast Lust darauf, Dinge aufzubauen, für die es noch keine fertige Anleitung gibt.
Du fühlst dich in einem schnellen Start-up-Umfeld wohl, übernimmst Verantwortung und möchtest Strukturen nicht nur nutzen, sondern aktiv mitgestalten.

Rebranding, Retail-Launch, ein Creative Squad mit vollem Kalender: dafür braucht es klare Taktung.

Moderation der Sprintplanung und aller Squad-Rituale: Daily Standup, Planning, Review
Ressourcen- und Kapazitätsmanagement für PR, Design, Video und Brand Activation nach Priorität

Timeline- und Budgetmonitoring für alle laufenden Brand-Projekte inklusive konsequenter Deadline-Durchsetzung – etwa bei Rebranding- oder Retail-Launch-Projekten

Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Creative Operations, Kreativproduktion oder Projektleitung im Kreativ-/Marketingumfeld
Erfahrung in der Führung von Teams mit kurzen Entscheidungs- und Feedbackzyklen, z. B. weekly Performance-Reporting, und laufende, datenbasierte Neu-Priorisierung
Starkes Verständnis für kreative Prozesse und die Fähigkeit, Timelines auch in dynamischen Episoden risikofrei durchzusetzen
Kommunikations- und Mediationsstärke an der Schnittstelle zwischen Daten und Kreation
Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau, Englisch ab B2
Scrum-/Kanban-Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss

Full Mobile Office Work & Flexibilität: Arbeite deutschlandweit mit maximalem Vertrauen
30 Urlaubstage + 2 Charity-Tage on top
Corporate Benefits, Fitnesszuschuss, mentale Gesundheits-Plattform (Nilo Health)
Mobilitäts-Zuschuss, Tierpatenschaft, Teamevents, Produktpakete
Und am wichtigsten: immer ein offenes Ohr für dich!

Bist Du überzeugt?

Wir sind auf der Suche nach Menschen, nicht Computern - wenn etwas nicht ganz auf dich zutrifft, deine Skills und Werte sonst aber zu uns passen, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung:-)

Schau' wenige Tage nach dem Versenden deiner Bewerbung sicherheitshalber bitte auch in deinem Spam-Ordner nach einer Mail von uns nach.

Über uns

Wir sind MetaFlow - bei uns triffst du auf ein Team, das Verantwortung übernimmt, offen für neue Ideen ist und sich nicht an Altem festhält, nur weil es "schon immer so gemacht wurde".

Wir glauben daran, dass gute Zusammenarbeit auf Vertrauen basiert, und darauf, dass alle ihren eigenen Beitrag leisten können. Unser Team baut seit 2018 starke Brands und konzentriert sich seit 2021 verstärkt auf die Marke MetaFlow.

Unsere Idee: Einen gesunden Lebensstil so einfach wie möglich in den Alltag integrieren. In Rekordzeit haben wir uns mit unserem speziellen Stoffwechsel-Shake zu einer starken Consumer Brand entwickelt.

Jetzt geht unser Weg weiter: Wir entwickeln neue Produkte, helfen noch mehr Menschen und wachsen auch als Team!

Statt steifer Hierarchien findest du bei uns ehrliches Sparring, kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, mitzugestalten. Ob in Marketing, Product, People oder anderen wichtigen Bereichen: bei uns erfüllst du nicht nur einen Job, sondern eine Aufgabe mit Sinn.

Lass uns gemeinsam etwas bewegen und Menschen auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Gesundheit begleiten!

Die omos media GmbH ist Arbeitgeber hinter mehreren Marken, darunter auch MetaFlow, Sanamana und WonderFast.

jobs.title: Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
(m/f/d)

About Stratio

Stratio keeps public transport running. We monitor fleet health in real time and tell the world's largest operators exactly what's going to fail before it does.

We're a small, technical team of about 50 people. There's no marketing department. You'd be building it.

The role

Our go-to-market runs on industry events. You own them end to end, and the content, the website and the automation around them.

This is a hands-on, one-person marketing function. No team to manage. You’ll brief a stand builder, a film crew, a designer or a PR freelancer when the work calls for them, and do everything else yourself. You do the work. You own the output. You use every tool available - especially LLMs and automation - to do the work of an entire department.

You’ll report directly to leadership and work closely with sales and product.

If you've ever been the only marketing person at a company and thrived, this is for you.

What your weeks look like

Events and speaking

Events are a major focus of this role. You run the event calendar: the shows where we exhibit, the conferences where we speak, and our own customer roundtables, on-site events at client sites and client advisory board.

For each stand: the booking, the design, the build contract, logistics, staffing, the run of show and the debrief.

For each talk: the abstract, the co-speaker, the deadline, the deck, the rehearsal.

After every event you report meetings held against meetings booked, deals generated and deals impacted, and you follow up with the leads generated in cooperation with our sales team to ensure event leads become opportunities in our pipeline.

Content creation

You write and publish case studies, blog posts, landing pages, LinkedIn posts, one-pagers, and sales enablement materials.

You produce our benchmark report with engineering, the abstracts and decks for our speakers, and the trade-press pushes around them.

You take raw inputs - a customer success metric, a product update, a conversation with a customer - and turn them into compelling stories.

You use LLMs daily to draft, iterate, and repurpose content across formats and channels.

You move fast without sacrificing quality.

Website ownership

You manage and update the website. New pages, copy changes, landing pages for campaigns, event pages and meeting-booking pages. You’re comfortable in a CMS. You don’t file a ticket to change a headline, you just do it.

You optimize for both traditional SEO and LLM discoverability, making sure that when someone asks “what’s the best predictive maintenance product,” Stratio shows up in the answer.

Campaigns and demand generation

You plan and execute campaigns to build our pipeline. They’re designed around the event calendar: the outreach that fills the meeting schedule before each show and the follow-up after it, webinars between events, LinkedIn content, paid only to named accounts, co-marketing with partners.

You draw up the account list for each event with sales, run the outreach and fill the calendar.

You set up tracking, measure what works, and kill what doesn’t. You think in terms of pipeline contribution.

Sales enablement

You build the materials that help the sales team close. Pitch decks, case studies, proposal templates.

You sit close to sales conversations and notice when the same objection keeps coming up, then you build something to handle it.

Analytics and reporting

You set up and maintain marketing analytics.

Per event: meetings held against booked, deals generated, deals impacted, what the field taught us and what we change because of it.

Website traffic, content performance, email metrics.

In the end how much pipeline we’ve generated, from which channels. You also can explain in simple terms what’s working, what’s not, and why. You don’t need a BI team to pull numbers.

Automation and tooling

You build workflows that save time. Email sequences, content distribution, lead scoring, social scheduling, speaker deadlines, meeting booking, post-event follow-up.

You use LLMs, no-code tools / light scripting to automate repetitive work.

You’re always looking for the next thing that should be a workflow instead of manual effort.

What we’re looking for

Must Have:

3 to 7 years in B2B marketing, ideally with some exposure to technical or industrial products
You’ve run B2B trade show or conference presence end to end at least twice: negotiated the space, briefed the stand builder, pre-booked the meetings, ran the floor, did the follow-up and reported the result
You’ve secured speaking slots through calls for papers or curated programmes, ideally with a customer on stage
You’ve run account-based outreach to a named list, with sales, and can show what it produced
Strong writing skills - you can explain complex technical value clearly and without jargon
Daily, fluent use of LLMs as real working tools, not "I use ChatGPT to brainstorm"
Comfortable updating a website in a CMS without help
Comfort with data: you set up tracking, read dashboards, and make decisions based on numbers
Self-direction: you don’t wait to be told what to do next
Comfortable with travel: you attend every event on the calendar, which means one trip almost every month, mostly in Europe, some long-haul.

Strong Plus:

You’ve run a customer advisory board, a customer roundtable programme or a reference programme
Website skills beyond the CMS: basic HTML/CSS, SEO fundamentals, and awareness of LLM optimization
Experience with automation tools (Make, Zapier, n8n) or basic scripting (Python, JavaScript)
Background in mobility/transport, IoT, or industrial tech
Experience marketing to enterprise buyers with long sales cycles
Design skills (Figma, Canva) for quick asset creation

What this is not

This is not a brand strategy role. It’s not a “manage agencies and review decks” role: you'll brief a stand builder, a film crew, a designer or a PR freelancer when the work needs them, and you'll do the rest yourself.

It’s not a role where you spend three months building a brand book before producing anything. You’ll be creating and shipping from week one.

It’s not a pure events role either. A stand only pays if the meetings were booked before the show, the case study on the table is good and the follow-up lands. The content, the website and the automation are what make the events work.

Why this is interesting

You'd own marketing entirely. No team inherited, no playbook to follow, at a company with real customers, real revenue, and a product that genuinely works. The case studies write themselves: 66% towing reduction, 25% spare fleet reduction, 20% fewer on-road breakdowns. The challenge isn’t inventing a story. It’s telling it well, to the right people, at the right time.

You’d have the autonomy to build the marketing function your way, with a leadership team that understands the value of modern, technical, AI-native marketing.

What we offer

Health Insurance to you and your children;
Fringe Benefits Policy (for Portugal located workers);
Flexible Work Hours - adjust your schedule to your needs;
22 vacation days, plus up to 3 extra time off days according to your tenure;
Work Setup - remote, hybrid, onsite - if your job can be done remotely, and you prefer to, you’re free to choose;
Hardware and software for a remote setup;
Quarterly Events to discuss Strategy;
Autonomy and Ownership Culture;
Continuous feedback culture;
Innovation Mindset;
Career Acceleration.

Location

Remote (Portugal) .

This role can be performed remotely, onsite, or on a hybrid setup in Coimbra, Portugal.

Regardless of the arrangement, availability to attend in-person meetings at our Coimbra office is expected when required. An average of once every two weeks should be expected. During onboarding expect it to be more regular to meet in person with the team and ramp up quickly into our operations.

What you can expect during the recruitment

Screening call with HR

Screening with HR

Interview with Hiring Manager (1h w/ HR and Hiring Manager)

We want to get to know you better and navigate through your experience, skills and motivation.

Work Simulation Live Exercise (1h w/ Hiring Manager and Job Role Stakeholders)

Context previous to the interview will be provided.

Expert Conversation (1h w/ Hiring Manager and an expert on this function)

A conversation about the role and how you would approach it, with a senior marketing or commercial leader who knows this kind of job from the inside.

Cultural Fit Interview (1h w/ Head of People and Founders)

Validate the cultural fit between you and Stratio and make sure you’re the person we’re looking for to help us build a #zerodowntimefuture.

Hiring Proposal
References may be required at any stage of the recruitment process.

AI & Transparency

We use AI-supported tools to help our team through the hiring process, here's how:

AI-assisted CV review: summarizes and suggests points for the hiring team to consider and help the team review applications faster; it does not make or influence hiring decisions.
Profile anonymization: your name, gender, and other personal identifiers are hidden during early screening to avoid bias.
Interview transcription: interviews may be recorded and transcribed to help our team focus on the conversation, with your consent.

Every decision about your application is made by a person from the hiring team. These tools assist our hiring team, they don't replace them.

About Stratio

Stratio delivers condition monitoring and predictive maintenance technology that powers a zero downtime future for transportation.

More than 1.3B people travel each year in vehicles using Stratio’s technology. The distance covered every day is remarkable, equal to 50 full journeys around the planet. Behind the scenes, more than 250 thousand maintenance predictions are generated daily, turning potential failures into planned interventions and keeping services running smoothly.

We want inspiring individuals in our teams, where age, race, gender, sexual orientation, politics and religion do not matter, and seek to create a tolerant and open space for everyone. We thrive to provide an inclusive and trustworthy environment.

You can find our Culture Manifesto and more team information here.

Take the road with us!

About BON CHARGE

BON CHARGE is a fast growing global wellness brand, offering the widest range of premium, science-backed products under one roof. Founded in 2017, BON CHARGE is a pioneering technology company dedicated to simplifying wellness by delivering innovative solutions that enhance sleep, recovery, beauty, and overall wellbeing.

With a bold vision for continued global growth, BON CHARGE is building a world-class team and this role is an integral part of our content and creative engine.

Role Overview

We’re seeking an organised and detail focused UGC Coordinator to support the sourcing and delivery of user generated content for BON CHARGE. You will find, vet, brief and manage UGC creators and review every piece of content they deliver for use across paid advertising, product pages and selected organic social channels.

This is an output driven role with a strong focus on content quality, brand and compliance alignment, and delivery volume. The role does not cover affiliate or paid influencer partnerships.

Key Responsibilities

Creator Sourcing & Vetting

Source UGC creators directly and via creator platforms (e.g. Insense or similar) across the wellness, biohacking, beauty, fitness and lifestyle niches
Vet creators for on-camera quality, audience fit, brand alignment and reliability before onboarding
Build and maintain a creator roster segmented by customer persona, product category and market (AU, US, UK, EU, CA)

Briefing & Creator Management

Write clear creator briefs covering product, persona, funnel stage, hooks, format, length and usage rights
Negotiate creator rates, deliverables and content licensing for paid, web and organic use
Manage product seeding, creator communication, deadlines and revisions end to end

Content Review & Quality Control

Review all delivered content against the brief, brand guidelines and product claim requirements before release
Coordinate claim and compliance checks with the Scientific Affairs and Compliance team
Manage revisions and reshoots, and ensure final files are named, tagged and stored in the UGC library

Delivery for Paid, Web & Organic

Deliver a monthly pipeline of UGC assets for paid media, including multiple hook variations per video, to the acquisition and performance marketing teams

jobs.title: Senior Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
Senior Creative Strategist (Remote - Anywhere)

About Us

Ancient Remedies is a fast-growing natural health and wellness brand on a mission to make the healing wisdom of nature accessible to people everywhere. We believe generations-old health knowledge deserves to be preserved, researched, and made practical for modern life—so we combine time-tested herbal wisdom with modern research through our books, guides, and wellness resources to help people make more informed health choices.

What started as a passion for natural healing has grown into a global brand serving hundreds of thousands of customers—and we're still building.

We're a remote, international, results-driven team that values ownership, speed, clear communication, and execution over bureaucracy.

At Ancient Remedies, you won't simply be filling a position. You'll have the opportunity to build, experiment, improve, and make a visible impact on a company that's continuing to grow.

The Role

As a Senior Creative Strategist, you'll turn performance data and market research into scroll-stopping ad concepts—headlines, hooks, and scripts—that ship across Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube. You'll work closely with media buyers, designers, and copywriters to test and iterate fast, always chasing what performs over what just looks good.

What You Will Own

Find useful insights in customer reviews, support feedback, past ads and competitor research. Separate what the evidence shows from what you still need to test.
Build distinct angles and hooks for paid social, with a clear audience, promise, reason to believe and test hypothesis.
Write direct-response scripts and briefs that an editor can use. Explain the opening visual, story, pacing and call to action.
Help choose what to test and what to change. Read results with media buyers, including spend, audience, conversion, refunds and contribution margin.
Turn both wins and losses into specific next steps. Know when to improve an execution, test a new angle or stop an idea.
Give useful feedback, share what you learn and help raise the team’s standard. Strong work can look different from your own style.
Use AI and research tools well. Check their output, protect source material and take responsibility for the final work.

What Strong Candidates Bring

Hands-on experience creating direct-response video ads for paid acquisition, with examples of scripts or briefs you personally shaped.
Evidence that you can repeat good work across more than one concept or campaign. You can explain your part in the result and the limits of the data.
Strong written English for customer-facing copy. You can make a complex idea easy to understand without inventing facts or making unsupported health claims.
Sound commercial judgment. You understand why a high click rate or a headline ROAS figure alone may not mean a profitable ad.
Clear briefs, reliable follow-through and a useful response to feedback. You can work across a remote team and raise blockers early.

Experience with health and wellness audiences, older consumers, Meta video ads or other paid video channels is useful. We care most about the work and how you think.

What Success Looks Like

In your first month
, you’ll learn our audience, products and review process, ship your first approved briefs and explain the thinking behind them.

By the end of your first three months
, you’ll own a clear cycle of research, concepts, production feedback and test learnings. We’ll review the quality of your decisions, how you work with the team and the commercial results of work that received a fair test. Your lead will set clear goals and review them with you throughout this period.

Why Join Us

Competitive salary - Benchmarked to market rate with regular reviews as we grow.
Performance bonuses - Your results are recognized and rewarded. We celebrate people who move the needle.
Fully remote - Work from wherever you do your best thinking. No commute, no compromise.
Flexible hours - Async-friendly and autonomy-driven. We care about output, not when you’re online.
22 days PTO - 22 days paid holiday plus 4 paid sick days — no questions asked.
WFH equipment budget - One-time budget to get your home office set up with the IT equipment you need from day one.
Learning budget - Annual allowance for courses, books, and anything that helps you grow.
Real ownership - At 100 people, your work has direct impact. No bureaucracy, no waiting for permission.
A team that cares - Genuinely warm, highly productive people who show up for each other as much as for the work.
Room to grow - We’re scaling fast. The role you start in today can grow into something much bigger tomorrow.
Monthly Performance-based Creative Bonuses.

How To Apply

Send your CV or profile and two examples of paid-ad work. For each, tell us what you personally did, what happened and what you’d improve. Use anonymized work or a clear written case if client confidentiality limits what you can share. Do not send confidential account access or data you don’t have permission to disclose.
Our process is:
a short application,
a recruiter prescreen,
a five-minute walkthrough showcasing your work
conversation, and one focused discussion about your work.

We’re hiring mainly at Senior level. We may consider a strong Associate where the scope fits, using the same practical assessment and a clearly stated level and pay range.

Please note:
Although the job posting is listed in Germany, this is a fully remote position and we're open to candidates from anywhere.

If you’re ready to grow fast, ship relentless creative, and see your words drive millions in revenue, we want to meet you.

All applications will be treated strictly confidential.

Only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

Thank you for applying!
